molecule.title: Genome — molecular plate
molecule.subtitle: The backbone is what you listen to; the rungs are what makes you unique.
molecule.svg_aria: Genome molecule: a DNA-shaped plot of your top genres and their secondary genre pairs
molecule.hint: Hover or focus any lit rung or backbone strand. The molecule holds still while you read.
molecule.no_bases: Not enough resolved listening yet to identify your top genres.
molecule.backbone_explainer: Each strand runs through your top genres in turn. A rung takes its colour from the strands it joins. The six brightest are where you sit furthest from average.
molecule.backbone_desc_empty: Not enough resolved listening yet to blend a backbone.
molecule.mix_unknown: Genre mix not yet known — still resolving.
molecule.leg_aria: Backbone strand, blend of {count} base genres
molecule.leg_aria_empty: Backbone strand, not enough data yet to blend
molecule.legend_over: Overexpressed — you play this far more than the average listener: at least twice the baseline share.
molecule.legend_stable: Stable — close to the baseline. Present in your listening at roughly the rate it is present in everyone's.
molecule.legend_under: Underexpressed — present, but well below the baseline: under 70% of the average listener's share.
molecule.legend_note: Measured against a reference profile built from global ListenBrainz listening, so “average” means average across many people, not across your own library.
molecule.mix_lead: Every rung is mixed from the four base genres above, in proportion to how much of that genre's listening belongs to each.
molecule.mix_pure: Almost all one base — the rung takes that base's colour outright.
molecule.mix_blend: Split between two bases — the rung lands on the colour between them, and belongs to neither.
molecule.mix_even: Spread evenly across all four — the colours cancel and the rung comes back nearly grey. That is the honest reading: no particular allegiance.
molecule.mix_note: Brightness is separate: the six rungs where you diverge most from the baseline are shown in full colour, the rest in the same hue drained back.

molecule.legend_unmeasured: No baseline — the reference profile is built from the world's most-played artists, so quieter genres are absent from it entirely. Your listening here still counts; there is simply nothing to compare it against.

eclecticism_tooltip: The effective number of genres in your listening — the count you would have if your play time were spread evenly across that many. A library dominated by one genre scores near 1 however many genres it technically contains.
eclecticism_no_baseline: No baseline to compare against yet
unresolved_title: Some artists could not be identified
unresolved_body: {failed} artist(s) failed to resolve against MusicBrainz and are no longer being retried on every pass. Their listening still counts; only their genre and era are missing.
unresolved_dialog_hint: These artists' names could not be matched against MusicBrainz. Their plays still count toward your totals; only their genre and era are missing.
unresolved_what_to_do: A lookup failure usually comes down to how the artist is named in your library — a compilation credit, a “feat.” string, or a typo will not match anything in MusicBrainz. Fixing the tag and rebuilding is the real repair. If it was just a bad night for the network, try them again.
unresolved_dismiss_hint: Dismissing hides the notice for exactly these artists. If different ones fail later, it comes back.
